metadata.scope: SDM target checklist plus selected additional records found while reading. Not a final exhaustive catalogue of all Ithomiini.

beccaloni_symbol_legend.●: plausible hostplant record in Beccaloni catalogue
beccaloni_symbol_legend.○: dubious hostplant record in Beccaloni catalogue
beccaloni_symbol_legend.□: erroneous hostplant record in Beccaloni catalogue

metadata.confidence_rule: high = direct species-level larval/oviposition/rearing evidence in a primary source or Costa direct table; medium = accepted catalogue record needing primary-source verification or probable/near species plant ID; low = dubious catalogue record/inference; exclude = erroneous catalogue row.
principal_sources: Beccaloni, G.W., Viloria, A.L., Hall, S.K. & Robinson, G.S. 2008. Catalogue of the Hostplants of the Neotropical Butterflies.
Costa, F. 1999. New records of larval hostplants for Ithomiinae butterflies. Revista Brasileira de Biologia 59(3): 455-459. doi:10.1590/S0034-71081999000300010
Willmott, K.R. & Freitas, A.V.L. 2006. Higher-level phylogeny of the Ithomiinae. Cladistics 22:297-368. doi:10.1111/j.1096-0031.2006.00108.x

audit_findings_for_existing_json: Do not store a single genus-level association as high confidence unless species-level records support it.
Athesis and Patricia should be represented as Capsicum-clade records, not generic Solanum.
Melinaea/Eutresis/Olyras should be represented as Solandra-clade Solanaceae records, with host genera such as Juanulloa, Schultesianthus, Solandra and related genera, not simply Solanum/Juanulloa.
Hyposcada/Megoleria require review because Willmott & Freitas state they feed on Gesneriaceae; the preliminary JSON Solanum/Prestonia entry is unsafe.
Pseudoscada and Greta should not be reduced to Solanum: Pseudoscada erruca/timna records are Cestrum/Sessea; Greta records are mainly Cestrum/Sessea.
Sais rosalia has Beccaloni records in Lycianthes, but Willmott & Freitas 2006 stated no confirmed Sais records; mark as needs primary-source verification.
